nodes.label: 3DPR Team Photo — Launch Night
nodes.description: Group photo of six students (5 visible fully, 1 partially) on an outdoor athletic field at night under stadium lights. They are holding the green 3D-printed rocket together with outstretched hands. All are smiling. Background shows a lit sports field, stands/bleachers, and a building. This is the project team celebrating after the launch. The green rocket is clearly visible being held collaboratively.
